research_question: Does a fixed one-shot description-only LLM extractor outperform a reasonable fixed rule extractor in semantic selection and witness-justified downstream decisions on controlled policies using an unchanged static checker?
scope: Synthetic policy-description selection with controlled source pairings. Not new upstream bugs, independent real-project evaluation, or human-effort measurement.

test_design.description_labels: Researcher-authored before predictions; no test-model judging, not machine-proved natural-language gold.

information_boundary.rules_and_llm: Opaque task ID, same complete synthetic description and fixed analysis profile only. No label, family, source, oracle, reference contract, witness or other outputs.
information_boundary.constant_conditions: Assumed fixed contracts, not evidence-qualified description extractors.
information_boundary.compiler: Unchanged explicit obligation compiler; exact ordered list retained. E and E+V equivalent only in evaluation, no rewrite.

transport.model: Default service with user config ignored; record actual identity if exposed, otherwise null.
transport.commands: Fresh ephemeral isolated read-only directory, project docs disabled, JSON schema, audit all tool/action events.
transport.failed_or_rejected_response: Preserve raw logs; downstream null/Unknown but extraction class INVALID, never correct U.

preflight_gate: Freeze all descriptions, rules, prompt, labels, probes, expected matrix, methods/scripts/dependencies before six standard combinations. Require all determinate expected verdicts, preserved contracts, source certificates and independent native witness checks. On failure stop; do not repair analyzer, source, prompt or rule.
primary_metrics: 12-card semantic class confusion with invalid responses separate
Paired LLM-vs-rules correct downstream decisions on24nonnullcells withTP/FP/FN/TN/Unknown separately
Witness-justified alarms under gold policy; label-correct alarms with unjustified witnesses reported separately
8nonnullcards with correct semantic class and all3expected determinate results
U-card unwarranted contracts and consequent alarms, not staticFP/TN
unknown_policy: Retain Unknown reasons; positive recall denominator includes abstentions. Do not discard failures or treat matching Unknown as correct.
witness_policy: For each certificate and fixed probe, independently evaluate gold and selected obligations from native values/reward. Wrong-policy alarm can coincide with a genuinely buggy function yet have an invalid witness; this is not credited as verified detection gain. No observed reward fed into static APIs.
benefit_rule: More correct paired downstream decisions with no increase in erroneous decisions and no increase in unjustified alarm witnesses/U-policy obligations supports a bounded controlled gain. Addedcoverage withaddederrors is a tradeoff. Equal downstream results imply no observed detection gain. Compare fixedE/V too; beating null alone is not evidence.
statistical_scope: 12descriptions clustered in4authoredlanguagefamilies;24nonnullcells repeat6semantic/programcombinations. Report exact tables, no iid p-values/generalization/novel-bug counts.
stopping_rule: Single frozen batch; no outcome-driven task replacement, retry, prompt/rule tuning, source rewriting or analyzer expansion.
preservation: New directory only; all pre-existing experiment/dataset/output/submission files hash-snapshotted before work.
one_sided_scope: Audits only reward>=1 => selected necessary obligations. No_alarm does not prove complete reward-policy implementation: equality can under-reward the opposite valid label under V; token_only can under-reward case/whitespace variants. Under-rewarding, completeness, and U policies are not certified by these checks.
